content:
jeff: Heads-up — seeing weird routing for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Many requests with header `X-Model: large-v1` are hitting fallback `small-v2` instead of the pinned large model. :eyes:

maya: Ugh. Do we have a decision-log snippet? sampling might be filtering these out so we can't see the pattern.

jeff: Here is one of the decision logs (redacted):
```json
{
  "route": "model-routing",
  "headers": {"x-model": "large-v1"},
  "policy_evals": [
    {"rule_id": "hdr-override-12", "match": false, "reason": "header_key_mismatch"},
    {"rule_id": "default-route", "match": true, "selected": "small-v2"}
  ],
  "sample_rate": 0.05
}
```

linh: Wait — the log shows `headers` with lowercase `x-model`. The evaluator uses case-sensitive lookup in the header matcher. Did the ingress filter change?

phil: Yep — ingress v1.3 rolled yesterday. It normalizes headers to lowercase earlier in the chain. Our matchers were written assuming `X-Model` exact casing. That would make hdr-override-12 fail and fallback to default.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout ingress v1.3 completed 2026-03-15 22:05 UTC

maya: So options: revert ingress change, make evaluator header matcher case-insensitive, or add a normalization step in the routing layer. Quickest safe fix is to normalize header keys inside the evaluator and add tests.

jeff: Also, decision-logging sampling is low (5% in the snippet). I'll temporarily bump sampling to 100% for the route and enable full decision logs for 15m so we can observe the frequency. correlator=cor-1234

phil: Command to toggle (run from ops box):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/telemetry/routes/model-routing/logging" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"decision_log_sampling":1.0, "enable_full_logs":true, "duration_min":15}'
```

tracing-bot: trace 0x9f3a: route_eval -> evaluator.normalize_headers -> selector; kv-cache: miss; hdr-override-12 evaluated -> no match (key mismatch) -> default-route selected

maya: After enabling full logs for a few minutes, I see ~1.2k evals and ~18 instances where hdr-override-12 failed due to casing. Repro steps: send header `X-Model: Large-V1` (mixed case) and see fallback.

jeff: I'll push a patch to evaluator to normalize header keys (lowercase) and add unit/integration tests. Who can own canary verification post-deploy? @maya?

maya: On it — I'll run a 10% canary, monitor `routing.fallback_rate` and `decision_log.mismatch_count`. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/routing-models (watch the `fallback_rate` panel).

jeff: Thanks. Post-mortem action: ensure per-route sampling configs are prominent in the console and add an alert if fallback_rate > 0.5% for 1m. Also note that header-normalization is a cross-cutting concern — should be in a shared library, not duplicated.

phil: Opening PR now with the normalization + tests. ETA ~2h. :shipit:
